ratings.notes: miR-153 claim (PMID:29904399) appears directionally inconsistent—miR-153 targeting Runx2 3'UTR would suppress, not boost it. miR-23a direction also unclear.
Well-structured with species labels. miR-153 binding Runx2 3'UTR yet activating it is mechanistically ambiguous. miR-23a direction noted as uncertain.
Many claims (miR-29b/DUSP2, miR-146a/TRAF6, miR-133a/135/214) lack cited PMIDs; appear fabricated or unsupported. Overstates evidence significantly.
Most comprehensive; includes exosome/miR-331-3p angle with PMID. miR-23a direction inconsistency noted. Testable hypotheses and clinical translation add strong research value.

result.pairwise_reason: Q001-D covers the broadest mechanistic scope with species labels, PMIDs, novel exosome angle, and actionable hypotheses, making it most complete and research-valuable despite shared miR-23a ambiguity.
